body:
## Why

The earlier EKF demo was not acceptable proof that the algorithm was authored in Mech because it called bespoke `ekf/*` resident operations and its comparison path shared the same Rust math helpers. This PR replaces that evidence with a deliberately small, human-checkable Mech program and an executable that fails closed.

## What the demo proves

- Prints the complete five-line Mech source and parser result.
- Compiles through the standard catalog and requires the artifact graph to be exactly `math/mul`, `math/add`, `compare/lt`, and `core/assign`.
- Fails if any hidden `ekf/*` or other operation appears.
- Prints type-binding evidence, artifact revision, decoded-bytecode revision, activated plan, resident slots, and memory layout.
- Runs both the source artifact and decoded bytecode against the literal oracle `5, 13, 29, 61, 125, 253, 509`.
- Compiles a source-only perturbation from `x * 2 + 3` to `x * 3 + 4`, then requires a changed artifact revision and the separate literal outputs `7, 25, 79` with the same four-operation graph.
- Rejects candidate `1021` and verifies epoch, state hash, state, and output remain unchanged.
- Deliberately verifies parser, type, missing-operation, bytecode, artifact, and memory-budget rejection paths.

## Honest boundary

The algorithm is composed in Mech. The four disclosed primitive operations are native standard-library implementations, as expected for compiled language primitives. This PR makes no claim of an independent implementation of EKF mathematics.

## Run

```sh
./scripts/demo-r-stack.sh
./scripts/demo-r-stack.sh --dump all
```

## Validation

- `cargo run -p mech --no-default-features --features r_stack_trust_proof --example r-stack-trust-proof`
- `./scripts/demo-r-stack.sh --dump all`
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `sh -n scripts/demo-r-stack.sh`

All commands above pass. A separate full-workspace Clippy run with an additional blanket `-D warnings` reaches pre-existing Clippy advisories in `mech-core`; normal compilation already enforces `-D warnings` through `.cargo/config.toml` and passed.
title: demo: add auditable v0.4 R-stack trust proof
